name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 3 visits over 10 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 23 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 10 hours starting 2025-07-02, at wavelengths from 0.85 to 4.79 µm. The pipeline found 3 moving objects.
